bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 71
id="${ids[0]}"
tag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$id")"
test "$tag" = "create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c" || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$id")" = true || exit 73
image_id="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$tag")"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$id")" = "$image_id" || exit 74
printf 'VIDEO_STARS_LIVE_READBACK=PASS\nPOLLER_COUNT=1\nIMAGE=%s\nRESTART_COUNT=%s\n' "$tag" "$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$id")"
